messages:
incident-bot: Paging: rotation alert — primary oncall (alex) removed from tonight's window (00:00-08:00 UTC) due to a family emergency. Automatic routing left unchanged. Please coordinate an immediate handoff or temporary override if you can cover. See runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/oncall-handbook

mei: ugh, thanks for the heads up. alex — everything ok? do you want me to spin up a temporary primary?

alex: thanks team. yes i'm OOO til morning. appreciate if someone can be primary. i can still slack/phone but can't take pages. sorry for the late notice.

priya: i can take primary for the first half (00:00-04:00 UTC) then handoff to jorge if he's available. i'm in europe so that slot aligns w/ my night.

jorge: i can take 04:00-08:00 UTC, happy to be secondary earlier if needed. question — does rotation need manual override or can oncall-rotation-bot do a temp swap?

mei: oncall-rotation-bot supports temp assignments but it's flaky with concurrent overrides. simplest is manual escalation changes in PagerDuty and note in the #incidents channel. i'll do the PD override unless priya wants to set it.

priya: i'll ask oncall-rotation-bot to set me as primary 00:00-04:00. command below:

```
@oncall-rotation-bot override --user priya --start 2026-03-14T00:00Z --end 2026-03-14T04:00Z --reason "cover for alex"
```

mei: kk i'll handle PD manual override for 04:00-08:00 to jorge and leave notes. jorge — can you confirm you'll be reachable by phone for any Sev1s?

jorge: yes phone on, will accept calls. set my escalation to mobile.

incident-bot: Note: customers with active sessions on dedicated clusters in eu-west-1 may see increased error retries during the handoff window if a hotpath hits a cold model. If an alert triggers, follow the 'model-serving-degradation' runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/model-serving-degradation

mei: good call. priya/jorge — please keep these sticky runbook steps in mind if latency or 5xx spike: 1) check autoscaler logs, 2) confirm fallback model is enabled, 3) if >5min outage, communicate to #support with template below.

priya: copying template to be safe:

```
Subject: Temporary degradation for hosted inference in eu-west-1
Time: 00:15 UTC
Impact: higher retry rates for a subset of customers; no data loss expected
Action: engineers are investigating, fallback model enabled, will update every 15m
```

mei: also please run the quick health checks before you accept primary: `kubectl get pods -n inference --selector=role=frontend -o wide` and `redis-cli -h cache-eu info` — if >10% pods crash, escalate to eng-runtime.

priya: ran the checks locally against staging and all green. will run prod check at 23:45 UTC and confirm here.

alex: thank you all, i'm really grateful. i left a quick note in my PD profile about my availability.

jorge: confirmed — i'll take 04:00. priya, if you want, leave me a short handoff note (key sessions, any ongoing incidents) right before 04:00.

priya: will do. quick heads-up: customer 'MapStream' had a transient 504 earlier but it auto-recovered; i left logs in the incident channel. not expecting carry-over but flagging.

mei: perfect. i'll update the #incidents pinned message with the temporary overrides and tag support. tagging @support-lead so CS can prep messaging if needed. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Action logged: temporary manual overrides set by mei (PD override for jorge 04:00-08:00). oncall-rotation-bot status: pending confirmation for priya override.

priya: override confirmed by bot. i'm primary 00:00-04:00. will post a 30m-before handoff reminder.

mei: thanks everyone. brief summary for the record: alex OOO; priya primary 00:00-04:00; jorge primary 04:00-08:00; mei did PD override for jorge; priya set bot override. runbooks linked above. any critical alerts — escalate to eng-runtime after 10m if not resolved.

jorge: copy. i'll post 'handoff accepted' at 03:50 and include runbook checklist.

mei: closing the loop — i'm reachable if either of you need backup but won't be primary. good luck and thanks. :heart:
